name: steer-traffic-scheme
operation: a merchant's period fees recomputed per card scheme, then argmin or argmax
invariant: min-scheme ≠ max-scheme; per-scheme totals reconcile with F03's total

canonical_method.helper: total_fees_paid(fees, scheme-filtered transactions, ...) per month, summed per scheme — needs resolution before shipping
steps: for each scheme: for each month: stats = monthly_merchant_stats(payments, merchant, year, month) computed over ALL of the merchant's transactions that month (not scheme-filtered) so the fraud/volume bucket reflects real merchant behaviour

fee_dict = total_fees_paid(fees, scheme-and-month-filtered transactions, account_type=..., mcc=..., capture_delay=cd_bucket, monthly_fraud_level=stats['monthly_fraud_level_bucket'], monthly_volume=stats['monthly_volume_bucket'])

conflict_ruling: Cannot rule cleanly: tasks 2766 and 2765 computed the SAME merchant/year/scheme (Rafa_AI, 2023, TransactPlus) and got TransactPlus flagged as BOTH the minimum (437.25) and the maximum (7700.35) across two different probe tasks — an outright contradiction. This means at least one run's monthly_fraud_level/volume bucket was computed inconsistently (most likely: one used the scheme-filtered subset to derive the monthly bucket instead of the merchant's full monthly transactions, understating or overstating volume).
pitfalls: Using the scheme-filtered subset (instead of the merchant's full monthly transactions) to compute monthly_merchant_stats produces a different, wrong volume/fraud bucket per scheme — the bucket must come from the merchant's total monthly activity
3 of 4 probe tasks disagreed between pass 1 and pass 2 — this family is currently the least stable in the probe
No dev-10 anchor exists to settle the ambiguity
prompt_rule: if the question asks which card scheme a merchant should steer traffic to for min/max fees → do NOT ship this family's system.md rule until the optimiser resolves whether the monthly bucket should be computed on the scheme-filtered or full-merchant transaction set; flag every such answer as unverified in the interim.
note: Highest-confidence correctness bug found in the probe besides F10 — same merchant/year/scheme contradicted itself across two tasks.
